objective: Close Phase 9 item C27: the tasks of odd/tasks/phase9-c27-review-recall.md, so that causes (1) and (2) of the C26 diagnosis are tested by an A/B on R24-R33 with 3 runs per case, what the A/B keeps is built into our review, and it is measured against gentle-ai with 3 runs per case on a fresh hold-out R34 onward.
scope: The specs S1-S6 of odd/tasks/phase9-c27-review-recall.md; one workflow and one role chain for each task.
constraints: The builder builds only a task the shaper designed.
The A/B of S2 runs outside the repository and the review-bench clone, its arm texts and its gate are fixed before any reply is read, and C27 stops after T1 when the gate does not pass (S2).
The fresh hold-out R34 onward is picked mechanically, without reading a defect before the pick, and no R34-onward defect text, class or diff enters a design artifact (S3).
The bar, gentle-ai's score sum and prompt bytes over 3 runs per R34-onward case, is written in the Log before the first T4 commit and is not changed after (S3).

Gentle-ai and our review are scored by the scoring rule of C25 L3 on the same cases and the same number of runs, with prompt bytes from the same shim; a run that ends without a result scores 0 with its bytes and is never repeated (S3, S6).
The parser change of S5 is its own task and commit, with Risk: 3 and the independent verifier (T5).
Every commit is reviewed or exempted, and labdrian review check clears it.
non_goals: Cause (3) of the diagnosis: splitting our lenses as gentle-ai's (S1).
Changing the role chain before the verdict of T6.
Changing the scoring rule of C25 L3.
Retuning the arm texts, the preamble, the row or the parser rule on the scores of T1 or T6.
acceptance_criteria: T1-T6 of odd/tasks/phase9-c27-review-recall.md are checked off, each with its commit, or C27 is stopped at the gate of S2 with the A/B entry in the Log.
The Log holds the bar entry of T3 before the first T4 commit and the verdict entry of T6 against exactly those numbers.
labdrian review check --onto main clears the head of each task's pull request.
runtime_scope: Claude Code, as the parent that runs the labdrian workflow and the role agents.
delivery_boundary: Work-unit commits on the branches of odd/tasks/phase9-c27-review-recall.md; push, pull requests and merges remain the owner's decisions under ordinary repository policy.
